title: docs: published text no longer teaches the retired view-level `provider: 'api'` (objectui#12364)
body:
Fixes #12364
Clause-②: no

Published text in objectui still taught the view-level `provider: 'api'` data source after objectui#12325 (PR #12361) deleted every reader of it. It also called `apiFetch` that provider's channel. This PR corrects the text to what is true now: a view binds `provider: 'object'` or `provider: 'value'`, and a metadata-declared API call is the page element's `dataSource` binding.

**Text only.** No schema's accept set moves and no renderer behaves differently. Outside comments, every changed line is a string literal's content (a `describe()`, an input `description`, an `Error` message, a test title or a test's pin literal), a markdown line, or a README code-fence line.

## One premise corrected: what `apiFetch` serves

The card proposed the sentence "`apiFetch` serves code-built `ApiDataSource` instances". Measured on `main` (1040a0a), that is not true:

- `ApiDataSource` never reads `SchemaRendererContext`. It takes `fetch` in its own config and falls back to `globalThis.fetch` (`packages/core/src/adapters/ApiDataSource.ts:158`).
- The only code-built instances (the approvals inbox, `apps/console/src/services/approvalRequestsDataSource.ts:255`) get `options.fetch ?? createAuthenticatedFetch()`, not the context's `apiFetch`.
- The context's `apiFetch` is read only by renderers making their own reads of the host's API: `ObjectChart` (metadata reads), `useDatasetDimensionLabels`, `useRecordEditable` and `useRecordCrudVerdicts` (record-permission probes).

So the text now says that. It follows the card's intent (correct each sentence to what is true now) rather than its proposed wording. The deviation is reported to the PM.

## Sites, before → after

Found by a repo-wide grep (all packages, apps, examples, `content/docs`, `skills`) for `provider: 'api'`, `provider: "api"`, `provider:'api'`, `api provider`, `` `api` provider ``, `object/api`, `api`/`value` pairs, and `apiFetch` in prose.

**Published text (descriptions, error text, READMEs, docs)**

| Site | Before | After |
|---|---|---|
| `packages/types/src/zod/objectql.zod.ts` (object-tree `data` `describe()`) | "the api and schema providers draw none on the tree" | "the schema provider draws none on the tree" |
| `packages/plugin-grid/src/index.tsx` (`data` input description) | listed `{ provider: "api", read, write }` | arm dropped; object, value and schema remain |
| `packages/plugin-map/src/index.tsx` (`data` input description) | "The `api` provider is not implemented on the map and plots no markers." | sentence dropped |
| `ObjectCalendar.tsx` (throw + comment), `ObjectGantt.tsx` (throw), `ObjectMap.tsx` (throw + comment) | `DataSource required for object/api providers` | `DataSource required for the object provider` (same conditions) |
| `content/docs/plugins/plugin-map.mdx` | quoted the old error | quotes the new error, as the error an object-bound map gets |
| `content/docs/plugins/plugin-calendar.mdx` | listed `{ provider: 'api', … }` among the refused config objects | that example dropped |
| `packages/react/README.md` | `apiFetch` "used by `provider: 'api'` view data sources … ApiDataSource falls back to the bare global fetch" | the host-authenticated fetch the renderers use for their own reads of the host's API; those reads fall back to the global fetch |
| `packages/auth/README.md` | `sameOriginOnly` "for fetches whose target URL comes from view metadata (`provider: 'api'` data sources)"; example const `apiProviderFetch` | "whose target URL may come from metadata (an API-call action's target)"; const `sameOriginFetch` |

**Docblocks and comments in published source**

| Site | Before | After |
|---|---|---|
| `packages/react/src/context/SchemaRendererContext.tsx` (`ApiFetch` docblock, nesting comment) | "used for `provider: 'api'` view data sources"; "provider:'api' auth survives nesting" | what it serves now, and that a view does not reach it; "the host's auth survives nesting" |
| `packages/app-shell/src/console/ConsoleShell.tsx` | "Authenticated fetch for `provider: 'api'` view data sources" | the host's authenticated fetch handed to the renderers as `apiFetch` |
| `packages/app-shell/src/hooks/useConsoleActionRuntime.tsx` | "matching the `provider: 'api'` data-source lane" | "matching the renderers' `apiFetch` lane" |
| `packages/app-shell/src/views/ObjectView.tsx` | example `data: {provider:'api', read, write}` | example `data: {provider:'value', items}` |
| `packages/auth/src/createAuthenticatedFetch.ts` (two places) | `provider: 'api'` data sources as a `sameOriginOnly` / data-lane user | an API-call action's target or the renderers' `apiFetch` |
| `packages/plugin-charts/src/ObjectChart.tsx`, `packages/plugin-detail/src/useRecordEditable.ts` | "the same channel `provider: 'api'` view sources use" | names `SchemaRendererProvider`'s `apiFetch` |
| `packages/types/src/objectql.ts` (`objectField`) | "an `api` provider composing parent-object rows with child-object rows" | "one source serving parent-object rows beside child-object rows" |
| `packages/core/src/utils/normalize-list-view.ts` | "`data` has four providers, `api`/`value` are read live in `ListView`" | "`data` has more providers than `object`, `value` is read live in `ListView`" |
| `packages/core/src/utils/record-source.ts` | "a `value`/`api`-backed block" | "a `value`-backed block" |
| `packages/plugin-list/src/ListViewBlock.tsx` | "a `value` / `api` provider" | "a `value` provider" |
| `packages/plugin-tree/src/ObjectTree.tsx` | "an `api`/`value` tree" | "a `value` tree" |
| `packages/plugin-view/src/ObjectView.tsx` | "gantt views fed by a composite api endpoint; without this pick the api provider never reaches the renderer" | "a gantt view on inline `provider: 'value'` rows; without this pick the view's `data` never reaches the renderer" |

**Test prose and pins**

| Site | Change |
|---|---|
| `examples/schema-catalog/test/catalog-gallery-render.test.tsx` | `DATASOURCE_REQUIRED` literal moves with the error text. It is a zero-count pin, so a stale literal would pass while catching nothing. Measured: the new spelling appears in all 5 throws and in the pin, and the old spelling has zero hits outside CHANGELOGs. |
| `packages/plugin-map/src/index.recordSourceInputs-10394.test.tsx` | drops the phrase pin for the dropped map sentence; docblock item 8 now describes the retired block. The behaviour row (a retired `api` block plots nothing, queries nothing, still shadows `staticData`) is unchanged. |
| `packages/plugin-gantt/src/ObjectGantt.test.tsx` | the title said "(api provider)" but the fixture is `provider: 'value'`; it now says "(inline value rows)" |
| `ObjectGantt.noSchemaZone-10866.test.tsx`, `approvalRequestsDataSource.test.tsx`, `createAuthenticatedFetch.test.tsx`, `impersonation-lane-4467.test.tsx`, `normalize-list-view.test.ts` | docblock or comment wording only, same corrections as above |

## Left alone, on purpose

- **Tests that pin the refusal or inertness of a retired `api` block:** `resolveDataSource.test.ts`, `ViewDataProvider.test.ts`, `useViewData.test.tsx`, `ObjectGantt.retiredApiProvider-12325.test.tsx`, `ListView.test.tsx`, `recordSourceInputs-10394` (gantt and map), `objectMapInputs-11168`, `objectTreeInputs-11168`, the `behaviourNeutrality` pair, and the properties-bag TRACE refusals.
- **Tests that use an `api` block as an opaque pass-through fixture:** `plugin-view` `ObjectView.test.tsx` and `ObjectView.namedViewProtocolKeys-8980.test.tsx`.
- **Comments that already say "retired":** in `ObjectGantt.tsx`, `ObjectCalendar.tsx`, `ObjectMap.tsx`, `ApiDataSource.ts`, `resolveDataSource.ts`, `ViewDataProvider.ts`, `useViewData.ts`, the gantt README and mdx, and `.changeset/12325-retire-api-view-data.md`.
- **Different things:** `type: 'api'` actions, `ApiDataSource` built in code, and HTTP API URLs.
- **Published CHANGELOG entries:** in app-shell, auth, core, plugin-calendar, plugin-charts, plugin-dashboard, plugin-gantt, plugin-grid, plugin-map, plugin-tree and react. Reported only, never edited. objectui has no `content/docs/releases/`.

## Acceptance notes

- **Spec-shape statements:** `objectql.zod.ts` docblocks at the gantt and grid block schemas, `imported-defaults-8317.test.ts:319`, and the two properties-bag test headers say the row "carries spec defaults (inside `data`'s `api` provider)". The test `gridDataInputContract.test.ts` "each of the four providers parses" does the same. All of these describe the installed `@objectstack/spec` 18.0.0-next.0, where the arm still exists, so they are true today and teach no authoring. They go stale with the spec bump. Carrier: objectui#12370.
- **Local identifier:** `ConsoleShell.tsx` keeps the local const name `apiProviderFetch`. Renaming it is a code change, which is outside this text-only card. It is unexported, so nothing outside the file sees it. Carrier: none.
- **Pending changeset:** `.changeset/12032-approval-requests-data-source.md:8` (not this card's) describes a past fix as "a record page over a `provider: 'api'` source". That is historical wording about the approvals `ApiDataSource`. It was left as is.

## Verification (head `66673ce`)

- **Targeted vitest (11 files, repo-root form, under the shared verify lock):** `Test Files 11 passed (11)`, `Tests 875 passed | 21 skipped (896)`, exit 0. Files: map `index.recordSourceInputs-10394`, `catalog-gallery-render`, `ObjectGantt.test`, `ObjectGantt.noSchemaZone-10866`, `normalize-list-view.test`, `approvalRequestsDataSource.test`, `createAuthenticatedFetch.test`, `impersonation-lane-4467`, `gridDataInputContract`, `gridNonAuthorKeys`, `objectTreeInputs-11168`.
- **Type-check:**
  - `@object-ui/types` and `@object-ui/auth` (no workspace dependencies): exit 0.
  - The other 13 changed packages: **NOT MEASURED**. Reason: each needs its dependency closure built, and the shared lock was held by a full-repo build. The changed lines are comments and string-literal contents only, so tsc's verdict cannot move. CI runs the full type-check.
- **Lint, narrowed to the 27 changed `.ts`/`.tsx` files:** `eslint --no-inline-config --format json` read 27 files, with 0 errors and exit 0. The population is the root `eslint.config.js`, which every package `lint` (`eslint .`) resolves. Type-aware linting is not enabled (no `parserOptions.project`/`projectService` in that config), so this diff cannot move the verdict on any untouched file.
- **Pre-tsc battery:** exit 0 for `phantom-deps`, `self-import`, `unreferenced-sources`, `doc-example-readers`, `handler-key-reads`, `side-effects-array`, `element-data-source-declaration`, `spec-symbols`, `action-forward-parity`, `designer-field-key-parity`, `icon-record-names`, `i18n-keys`, `i18n-drift`, `i18n-designer-parity` and `doc-fences`.
  - `check:spec-floors`: exit 1 ("The scan collapsed: 0 package(s) declare @objectstack/spec …"). This is the known `main` failure (objectui#12334, not this diff, which touches no `package.json`).
- **Changeset scripts:** `check-changeset-fixed`, `check-changeset-presence` and `check-changeset-no-major` all exit 0.
- **Control-byte self-scan of the changed files:** no hits.

Changeset: `.changeset/12364-provider-api-prose.md` (patch for types, plugin-grid, plugin-map, plugin-calendar, plugin-gantt, react and auth).
